rawContent: DEMocratic activist and #metoo proponent, Asia Argento, settled a lawsuit for sexual harassment stemming from sexual activities with an underage actor.

Remember the hope you felt, maybe as a survivor, when #Metoo was brought out into public convo initially? That we were going to unite to end sexual violence. Then the movement was hijacked and politicized. Can’t say I didn’t try. And I’m a conservative!
